name: Visit the Herbalist
label: Quest
description: Following a meal delivery to his remote post, Guard Parker asks a favor before you return to the Lakeshire inn. Hoping to express his feelings for Darcy…
intro: Following a meal delivery to his remote post, Guard Parker asks a favor before you return to the Lakeshire inn. Hoping to express his feelings for Darcy, he sends you to the local herbalist to purchase flowers. Parker insists that the herbalist not be told who ordered them or who they are intended for.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me? You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.
But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need a bouquet of flowers? You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?
I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... Especially in dangerous times like these.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
